svg.aria-label: Left: root mean square error of the value estimates on the 5-state random walk against the number of episodes, averaged over 100 runs, for TD(0) with step sizes 0.05, 0.1 and 0.15 and constant-alpha Monte Carlo with step sizes 0.01 to 0.04. TD's errors fall faster and lower. Right: on the 19-state random walk, the error averaged over the first 10 episodes against the step size, for n-step TD with n from 1 to 512; n equal to 4 reaches the lowest error, about 0.26, and both one-step TD and Monte Carlo are worse
svg.text: 5-state walk: TD (orange) learns faster than MC (blue)
RMS error over the first 10 episodes
